summary: Northwest Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a $4.9 million convertible promissory note financing with YA II PN, Ltd., managed by Yorkville Advisors. The 12-month note carries a 5% original issue discount, no interest, and converts at a discount to market. Yorkville also received a warrant for $2 million of shares at $0.205 per share and a $50 million standby equity subscription agreement. Proceeds support general corporate purposes. This is routine capital-raising, not a special-situation event.
